page.overview:
What is Professor Juniper?

Professor Aurea Juniper is the regional Pokémon professor of Pokémon Black and White, situated in the Unova region.

Professor Juniper is a tall woman with fair skin, green eyes, and poofy honey-colored hair. She wears a pale greenish-blue lab coat and a white blouse, along with a short green skirt and athletic white shoes with red stripes. She also has red rectangular earrings in both of her ears.

Her Japanese surname, Araragi, comes from アララギ (araragi, the Japanese name of the spreading yew). It may also come from あらら (arara), an extension of あら (ara), used in situations like "ah~!" or "oh my~!" (to express concern); she uses this as a catchphrase in her speech, too.

Her English surname, Juniper, could possibly originate from the "juniper" tree.
